select * from (SELECT S.BOOKSET_ID, C.BOOKSET_DATE AS MAXDATE, MIN(ifnull(B.BOOK_DATE,C.BOOKSET_DATE)) AS MINDATE FROM BOK_BOOKSET S INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND C.BOOKSET_DATE >= S.START_DATE AND C.BOOKSET_DATE <= S.END_DATE LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE = C.BOOKSET_DATE WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY S.BOOKSET_ID,C.BOOKSET_DATE ) T1, T2 AS( SELECT T1.BOOKSET_ID,ifnull(MIN(B.HAPPEN_DATE),STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')) HAPPEN_DATE FROM T1 LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = T1.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOK_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') WHERE T1.MAXDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AND T1.MINDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY T1.BOOKSET_ID ) SELECT S.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, C.BOOKSET_DATE as bookSetDate, 'QL' as backRange, E.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as bookDate, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId, STR_TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as happenDate FROM BOK_BOOKSET S INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND C.BOOKSET_DATE >= S.START_DATE AND C.BOOKSET_DATE <= S.END_DATE INNER JOIN T2 ON S.BOOKSET_ID = T2.BOOKSET_ID AND T2.HAPPEN_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON B.BOOKSET_ID = S.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE = C.BOOKSET_DATE LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL E ON E.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND E.BUSI_NO = B.BUSI_NO AND E.BUSI_TABLE = B.BUSI_TABLE AND B.HAPPEN_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{HAPPENDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AND B.BOOK_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{BOOKDATE,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
WHERE 1=1
AND S.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{item}
GROUP BY S.BOOKSET_ID, C.BOOKSET_DATE, E.BUSI_TYPE, B.BOOK_DATE, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID ORDER BY S.BOOKSET_ID,B.BOOK_DATE,happenDate ASC
